name: Djoudj National Bird Sanctuary
description: Djoudj Bird Sanctuary sits in the Senegal River delta in northern Senegal, northeast of Saint-Louis. Its 16,000 hectares of lakes, streams and backwaters are a first haven for birds that have just crossed the Sahara. Around 1.5 million birds winter here, among them huge flocks of white pelicans and flamingos, along with aquatic warblers arriving from Europe.
